# Archium

> An Arc and Zen style web browser built on Electron, with Helium's privacy defaults. MIT. For Arch Linux and macOS.

- [README](https://github.com/Gitguy268/archium#readme): install, features, shortcuts, CLI and MCP
- [Helium parity](https://github.com/Gitguy268/archium/blob/main/docs/helium-parity.md): which privacy defaults are covered
- [Architecture](https://github.com/Gitguy268/archium/blob/main/docs/architecture.md)
- [Security model](https://github.com/Gitguy268/archium/blob/main/docs/security.md)
- [Privacy test results](https://github.com/Gitguy268/archium/blob/main/docs/privacy-results.md)
